team_id.description: Workspace ID

order_by.description: Order by a particular field. By default, tasks are ordered by `created`. Options include: `id`, `created`, `updated`, and `due_date`.

reverse.description: Tasks are displayed in reverse order.

subtasks.description: Include or exclude subtasks. By default, subtasks are excluded.

statuses.description: Filter by statuses. Use `%20` to represent a space character. To include closed tasks, use the `include_closed` parameter. For example: `?statuses[]=to%20do&statuses[]=in%20progress`

include_closed.description: Include or excluse closed tasks. By default, they are excluded. To include closed tasks, use `include_closed: true`.

assignees.description: Filter by Assignees using people's ClickUp user id. For example: `?assignees[]=1234&assignees[]=5678`

tags.description: Filter by tags. User `%20` to represent a space character. For example: `?tags[]=tag1&tags[]=this%20tag`

due_date_gt.description: Filter by due date greater than Unix time in milliseconds.

due_date_lt.description: Filter by due date less than Unix time in milliseconds.

date_created_gt.description: Filter by date created greater than Unix time in milliseconds.

date_created_lt.description: Filter by date created less than Unix time in milliseconds.
